import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def solve_demo(n):
    Din=G[n+' input']; Do=G[n+' output']; H,W=len(Din),len(Din[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in Din for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rects=[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if Din[r][c]==3]
    rect_rows={r for r,_ in rects}; rect_cols={c for _,c in rects}
    res=[]
    for dr in range(H):
        for dc in range(W):
            ok=True; pred=[[None]*W for _ in range(H)]
            # build candidate: Din shifted
            cand=[[Din[(r-dr)%H][(c-dc)%W] for c in range(W)] for r in range(H)]
            good=all(cand[r][c]==Din[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if (r,c) not in [(r,c) for r in rect_rows for c in rect_cols])
            if not good: continue
            # 8-cells: anchors of horizontal 2-runs in Din
            eight=set()
            for r in range(H):
                c=0
                while c<W:
                    if Din[r][c]==2:
                        run=c
                        while run<W and Din[r][run]==2: run+=1
                        if run-c==1: eight.add((r,c))  # isolated, skip? keep
                        else:
                            # anchor: left end of run; but only if run isn't inside rect
                            if min(run-1, W-1) not in rect_cols or min(c, W-1) not in rect_cols:
                                pass
                    c+=1
                # simpler: anchors are runs with length>=1 whose left end exists; mark left end of every 2-run that lies fully outside rect or partially?
            # check consistency: every 8 in Do must equal an anchor cell per this shift

    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; rectc=[c for c in cnt if c not in (bg,2)][0]
    rset={r for r in range(H) if all(v==rectc for v in g[r])}

    # find actual tile size: pattern cells are small rectangles; try to find min bbox of the periodic unit outside rect

    rows_=sorted({r for r,_ in cells}); cols_=sorted({c for _,c in cells})
    print(n,'cell extents:',rows_[0],rows_[-1],cols_[0],cols_[-1],'H,W',H,W)
    # changed set from output
    ch={(r,c):d[r][c] for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if g[r][c]==2 and d[r][c]==8 and r not in rset and c not in cs_set}
